MASCOT GESTURES

MASCOT GESTURES

Festive Versatility & Localization

A core strength of Cookizza's identity is its ability to adapt to cultural moments while keeping its playful spirit intact.
Whether dressed in a songkok riding a vintage scooter for Hari Raya,

relatable voice that transforms simple baked goods into a memorable story.
